en: A sepia-toned postcard showing a narrow street bordered by old residential buildings, balconies with laundry hanging out to dry, lush trees, and a prominent clock tower with a spire in the background. The setting is distinctly European, with traditional architectural styles and cobbled pathway, giving a historical atmosphere. The text at the bottom of the postcard reads '11378 - Borgo Valsugana - Lungo Brenta Superiore.'
